The chip is real and works — filter==="new" → game.new===true, and since skai-gaming 6a098d2 it also scrolls the grid into view and retitles it "New games" (FILTERED_GRID_TITLES). But the old note's "not a separate screen" was a claim about the DESIGN, and it is wrong: 4714:31724 is a full dedicated screen, re-measured with get_metadata. Header 4714:31733 = back chevron + "New games" (24px icons/action at x=0) + Frame 655 (two 140x34 CTAs rendering as "Popular" and "All providers" dropdowns, x=822) + a 200x34 "Search games" box at x=1118; body Frame 631 (4714:50012) = a 9-tile grid (206x292 cells, rows of 6 then 3, 16px gutters), then the Top bets table (4714:50404), the hairline and Frame 641 About/FAQ/Licences. ★ Added 2026-08-26 (report 417f0de5, "in figma 'Popular games' is below 'Recently played' but in app it is 'Arcade games'"). The shelf and its POSITION were always right — Play.tsx renders it between ContinuePlaying and Arcade games, pinned by playSectionOrder.test.ts against frame 4714:32327 (Trending y0 · Providers y399 · Recently played y587 · Popular y986 · Arcade y1385, re-measured 2026-08-26; 4714:32563 is literally the text "Popular games", 153px). What was wrong is that the list was built from LIVE PRESENCE ONLY (gameCounts, the realtime channel) and PlayGameRail returns null for an empty list, so on this pre-launch casino the shelf erased itself almost always and Arcade took its slot. rankPopularGames now admits a second REAL signal — recent on-chain bets per game off useRecentBets — with presence still outranking it; a game with neither signal is still dropped and a silent casino still hides the shelf. NOTE the frame HIDES this family's view-all chevron (4714:32564) where Trending (9112:12989) and Arcade (4714:33258) show theirs.

Both halves are true and they are about different things. The NAV DESTINATION is live: HomeSidebarExpanded.tsx:1504 routes the row to /sports?tab=bookie, which renders src/pages/sports/components/BookieDashboard.tsx (1,231 lines reading SKAIHousePool shares/totalAssets, vault balance, on-chain referrals, tier_config) — so "missing entirely" is not accurate about the page. What is genuinely unbuilt is this family's ~10 CASINO Bookie frames as drawn. The LABELS the reports ask for were changed by Casey's own 2026-08-12 ruling on 86dd2c36 / 99a6423f / e216c5ef (Bookie → "House Pool" because one SKAIHousePool bankroll serves casino AND sports; Live RTP retired as a nav row and folded into /rewards, which mounts LiveRtpPanel at Rewards.tsx:171). Reverting to "Live RTP" and "Bookie" would REVERSE that ruling and is Casey's call, not a lane's — see report 49087b2b, already held for the same reason.

Publishing those would be a false public payout claim.
